notes.title: Hotfix for Game Launch Issues
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Add more error checking and logging for NVIDIA Streamline 
[*] Add entries in settings.ini for controlling  for NVIDIAStreamlineLog, NVIDIAStreamlineOTAUpdates
[code]NVIDIAStreamlineLog=Off           ; Values: Off, Default, Verbose
NVIDIAStreamlineOTAUpdates=On     ; Values: Off, On[/code]
[*]  When NVIDIAStreamlineLog enabled, a log file in the Save Game directory will be generated and overwritten every launch. If encountering errors, please submit a support ticket including this log.
[code]C:\Users\<USER_NAME>\Saved Games\God of War Ragnarök\sl.log[/code]
[*]  When disabling NVIDIAStreamlineOTAUpdates, the driver over the air updates will be disabled. If encountering errors, please try disabling.
[*] Update the PlayStation Overlay runtime installers to version 4.00
[/list]

notes.title: Black Screen Launch Issue Hotfix
notes.content:
An NVIDIA Driver Crash/Soft Lock that prevents the game from loading is under investigation. In the meantime, we've implemented a work around for the cause of the crash to change how shader compilation works. This change may cause some micro-stuttering during initial load, but will hopefully avoid the driver crash that prevents game from starting.

Please verify files after patching.

tags.bug: - An NVIDIA Driver Crash/Soft Lock that prevents the game from loading is under investigation.

tags.feature: - In the meantime, we've implemented a work around for the cause of the crash to change how shader compilation works.

notes.title: Update to Edit Appearance Feature & Armor of the Black Bear Set
notes.content:
Tomorrow on January 30th we will be releasing a patch to the PC and PlayStation versions of God of War Ragnarök with a few changes. 

[h2]Update to Edit Appearance Feature (AKA Transmog System) [/h2]
For all PlayStation and PC players, the Edit Appearance feature (AKA the Transmog system), will no longer require gear to be fully upgraded to level 9 and will instead be available from the beginning of the game.  

[h2]Armor of the Black Bear Set [/h2]
[h3]Updated PS4 & PS5 Access to the Armor of the Black Bear Set  [/h3]
After this update, PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5 players will also get access to the Armor of the Black Bear set (no NG+ save required) via the first available Lost Items chest in new and in-progress saves. 

[h3]PlayStation Network Sign-in Bonus on PC [/h3]
When signed into an account for the PlayStation Network when playing God of War Ragnarök on PC, you will gain access to the Armor of the Black Bear set for Kratos at the first Lost Items chest in the Realm Between Realms (previously only accessible in a New Game+ run) and a resource bundle.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040501/48a005551dec2c6946428470f9879b01e273ff67.jpg[/img]
This set includes:  
[list]
[*]Cloak of the Black Bear (Chest)  
[*]Wraps of the Black Bear (Wrist) 
[*]Belt of the Black Bear (Waist)  
[/list]
[list]
The resource bundle includes:  
[*]500 Hacksilver 
[*]250 XP
[/list]
For in-progress saves, you will be able to access the armor set and resource bundle in the Lost Items chest after the update is live.  

If you do not wish to log-in to an account for PlayStation Network while playing God of War Ragnarök on PC, you will [b]still be able to access the Armor of the Black Bear set in a New Game+ run (the same as before)[/b].  

Signing into the PlayStation Network will now be optional on God of War Ragnarök PC.

notes.title: Patch 7 Released
notes.content:
[h2][b]Updates[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Added more detection for corrupted files during content loading with a warning to user to validate files
[*] Fixed an issue where the window location would not be saved upon subsequent launches when running in windowed mode

[*] Fixed issues with volumetric fog looking blocky when playing in 21:9 or 32:9 aspect ratios
[*] Fixed an issue with interact/evade swapping not working when using SteamInput
[*] Fixed an issue with on screen prompts not properly reflecting correct button prompts when using Switch controller and SteamInput

[*] Fixed an issue where bindings using mouse scroll would get unset upon relaunching the game
[*] Improved performance on Intel ARC GPUs (has very minor improvement on NVIDIA and AMD)
[*] Fixed a number of visual bugs such as the water at the bottom of Alfheim well not appearing properly
[/list]
[i]Note - We recommend validating files after every patch.[/i]

notes.title: Patch 6 Released
notes.content:
[h2][b]Updates[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a crash in UI when opening certain Journal pages
[*] Fixed a crash that could happen when controllers get disabled or enabled in rapid succession
[*] Fixed a crash that would occur in various locations in Vanaheim
[*] Improved performance of AMD Zen1 and Zen2 processors in areas where the game was CPU limited
[*] Increased tessellation in Realm Between Realms back to PS5 quality
[*] Note that the performance issue related to tessellation is resolved in NVIDIA drivers 565.90 or higher
[*] Fixed an issue where lock on would rapidly bounce between targets when using mouse. It will now be more "sticky" requiring more effort to change targets
[*] Fixed an issue where attack indicators would not look correct when using frame generation
[*] Fixed an issue where cinematic dialogue audio would be lower volume than intended
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 5 Released
notes.content:
[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Prevent crash on game boot due to corrupt or missing files - game will now tell you that there are bad files and ask you to verify installation
[*] Volumetric fog in Realm Between Realms and during dream sequences will now appear properly on NVIDIA 10xx, 20xx, and 30xx cards
[*] DualSense controllers will now default to rumble backup when connected wirelessly as haptics are only available with wired connections 
[*] Achievements will now retroactively unlock when loading save games

[b]Please note[/b]: If you reload your save and your missing Achievements do not pop, this is likely due to something causing the Steam API to fail via a temporary block such as a firewall, internet disabled, etc. Please double-check possible blockers if this issue persists after reloading. 
[/list]

notes.title: God of War Ragnarök brings a host of new features to PC, available tomorrow
notes.content:
God of War Ragnarök is officially out tomorrow on PC!*  

All of us at Santa Monica Studio, alongside our development partners at Jetpack Interactive, are thrilled to be able to bring the sequel to God of War (2018) and the final chapter of the Norse saga to all our fans on PC. Alongside a new trailer, we’re also happy to share a short overview of the additional features and support we’ve included for launch!
[h3]New Features in God of War Ragnarök PC[/h3]
Debuting in the PC version of the game, and soon to be added to the console version, are two new settings to help you customize the way you play. 
[h3]
Reduced Puzzle Hints Option[/h3]
A new option in the Gameplay Settings tab, enabling this will reduce the frequency with which you hear puzzle hints from your companions! 
[h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040501/1b3434bfa7d1e35474ff71dda26975321322f722.png[/img]
Cinematic Audio Description [/h3]
Enabling the Audio Description setting under the Audio Accessibility menu will play audio descriptions of visual events during cinematics. These descriptions will provide additional contextual information alongside the spoken dialogue to create a more detailed experience for players with low vision. 
[previewyoutube=LokVCSsbFTQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Streamer Alerts [/h3]
As a thank you to all of our fans who take the time to stream the game to their friends and communities, we created custom alerts for you to use! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040501/7b54bbf6d5a78b361a827d25aef5f583e794ede8.png[/img]
Want Kratos to give your new subscriber a nod or Thor to rejoice at a channel follower? Get the [url=https://sms.playstation.com/documents/64/GoWR_PC_-_Streamer_Alerts_pdvFuj9.zip]full set here[/url] or download individually below!   
•	[url=https://sms.playstation.com/documents/66/New_Follower.zip]New Follower [/url]
•	[url=https://sms.playstation.com/documents/68/New_Subscriber.zip]New Subscriber [/url]
•	[url=https://sms.playstation.com/documents/65/New_Donation.zip]New Donation [/url]
•	[url=https://sms.playstation.com/documents/67/New_Gifted_Sub.zip]New Gifted Subscription [/url]
[h3]Fan Kit [/h3]
Ready for download, we’ve got a new fan kit ready our launch on PC! Inside you’ll have access to social media banners and wallpapers, including ultrawide options for those of you with supported monitors! 
•	[url=https://secure.cdn.us.playstation.com/god-of-war-ragnarok/fan-kit/god-of-war-ragnarok-PC-fan-kit.zip]Full Fan Kit [/url]
•	Wallpapers [16:9] – [url=https://sms.playstation.com/documents/61/GoWR_PC_Wallpapers_16-9_4K.zip]4K[/url] and [url=https://sms.playstation.com/documents/60/GoWR_PC_Wallpapers_16-9_1080.zip]1080p[/url]
•	[url=https://sms.playstation.com/admin/documents/edit/59/]Wallpapers [Ultrawide] [/url]
•	[url=https://sms.playstation.com/documents/62/GoWR_PC_Social_Banners.zip]Twitter Banners [/url]
•	[url=https://sms.playstation.com/documents/62/GoWR_PC_Social_Banners.zip]Facebook Banners [/url]

Whether you’re experiencing the final chapter of the Norse saga for the first time or picking it up again on a new platform, we hope your journey back into the Nine Realms and Valhalla is a ton of fun! 
[previewyoutube=nBwxyqq1ON4;full][/previewyoutube]
On behalf of everyone here at Santa Monica Studio and Jetpack Interactive, thank you so much for your continued support. 

[i]*PlayStation Network Account Required[/i]
